results.title: Leak: Fairphone 6+ appears in promo video, spec sheet reveals two upgrades
results.description: The launch of the Fairphone 6+ appears to be imminent, as leaks show the smartphone not only in what appears to be an official promotional video, but the complete spec sheet is also already available. According to the spec sheet, the Plus model will feature a new color and two hardware upgrades.
